ev.a_voyage.text.WAF: A caravan master you know is taking camels across the Sahara to Sijilmasa and has room for travelers with goods. Those who come back will sell at three times the price. Those who don't won't care either way.
ev.a_voyage.go.success.WAF: The journey paid off: the goods sold out the first day, and you came home burnt black by the sun, with a full purse and a dozen stories.
ev.a_voyage.go.failure.WAF: A sandstorm scattered the caravan, and you barely made it to a well. At least you're alive.
ev.a_voyage.send_goods.WAF: Send goods with the caravan master
ev.a_voyage.send_goods.success.WAF: The caravan master came back honest and with a profit. A rare stroke of luck.
ev.a_voyage.send_goods.failure.WAF: The caravan master came back empty-handed with a long story about desert raiders.
ev.j_up_ship.text.WAF: Three big cargo canoes are for sale at the landing, crews and all: the owner has grown rich and is retiring. You can buy them outright, or go in on shares with partners.
ev.j_ship_state.text.WAF: The court needs boats to carry grain from the ruler's estates to the capital. Those who carry it are promised steady pay and honors. Trading on your own account could bring twice as much, or nothing.
ev.j_ship_state.private.success.WAF: You guessed right with both the goods and the timing. The profit makes the court's pay look like small change.
ev.j_ship_state.private.failure.WAF: Market prices fell just before you arrived. The trip didn't pay for itself.
ev.j_ship_state.overload.success.WAF: The boats made it, though they sat in the water up to the gunwales. A huge profit.
ev.j_ship_state.overload.failure.WAF: An overloaded boat ran aground and capsized. The grain was lost, the paddlers barely escaped, and now people speak ill of you.
ev.a_father_story.text.WAF: {npc}, your father, is telling yet again how he nearly got rich on a salt caravan as a young man. Every year the caravan in the story gets longer and the sandstorm more terrible.
ev.a_neighbor_noise.text.1.WAF: The neighbor behind the wall is banging away at night again. At first you thought he was mending a mortar; now you suspect he's hollowing out a whole canoe.
ev.j_any_payday.text.WAF: The work is delivered, but the client keeps putting off payment: "any day now", "after the festival", "when the caravan comes in". You've been hearing it for two months.
ev.a_scribe_blot.text.WAF: You knocked the inkpot over a nearly finished manuscript. Three days' work spread into a blot shaped like a hippo. You had to recopy it until dawn.
